name: screenshot-case-slot
goal: Select reviewed screenshots by their bound case even when state and viewport slots repeat.

evidence: ScreenshotBaselineService selects by scenario, state, evidence and viewport before reading the bound unit and case, so two legitimate cases in the same slot are rejected as ambiguous.

The existing review and load cases used only one capture in each slot. Extend that same class case with two declared case bindings in one slot and an actual duplicate binding; keep the six registered titles unchanged.
